definitions.explanation: A nut with a spiny husk, or the tree that produces it. Chestnuts are a beloved autumn ingredient in Japanese cuisine.

examples.english: When autumn comes, we go chestnut gathering.
Chestnut rice is an autumn delicacy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{焼|や}き{栗|ぐり}→焼き栗：24146_yakiguri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
{栗|くり} refers to chestnuts and chestnut trees.

Common expressions:
- {栗|くり}⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧ (chestnut rice)
- {栗|くり}⟦{拾|ひろ}い→拾う：00845_hirou⟧ (chestnut gathering)
- ⟦{焼|や}き{栗|ぐり}→焼き栗：24146_yakiguri⟧ (roasted chestnuts)
- ⟦{甘栗|あまぐり}→甘栗：28493_amaguri⟧ (sweet roasted chestnuts)
- {栗|くり}⟦きんとん→きんとん：noentry⟧ (sweetened chestnut paste)
- {栗|くり}⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧ (chestnut brown color)
- ⟦{毬栗|いがぐり}→毬栗：28494_igaguri⟧ (chestnut in its spiny husk; also describes spiky hair)

Counter: ⟦{個|こ}→〜個：00645_ko⟧

Cultural note:
Chestnuts are an important autumn ingredient in Japan. {栗|くり}⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧ and {栗|くり}⟦きんとん→きんとん：noentry⟧ (often served at New Year's) are seasonal favorites. {栗|くり}きんとん from Nakatsugawa in Gifu is particularly famous. ⟦{甘栗|あまぐり}→甘栗：28493_amaguri⟧ (Tianjin chestnuts) roasted and sold by street vendors are a popular snack.
